market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$76.3k needs to fall ~35% to hit $50k. The 2026 YTD low is ~$63k. $50k requires significant additional decline below the existing low. Possible if Sept-Oct sell-off materializes, but not the base case.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Severity of the next downcycle and macro environment
